title.description: The public title deliberately supplied for this candidate.

url.description: Canonical public HTTP(S) URL only: no credentials, query parameters, or fragments. Query-bearing URLs are rejected because their parameters are not safely classifiable as public.

date.description: The intended public date in ISO 8601 calendar form.

image.description: Optional canonical public image URL with the same no-credentials, no-query, no-fragment policy as the destination URL.

take.description: Optional, exact first-person wording supplied by Kaleb. Never generated or transformed by the system.

draft.description: Capture requests are drafts and require normal editorial review before publication.
